protocol.same_samples: All methods share time splits, supervised minibatches, PDE collocation points, and initial-condition observations within each seed.
protocol.same_initialization: All PCA loss-weight variants start from identical parameter values for a given seed.
protocol.same_residual_operator: JAX autodifferentiation is used for u_t, u_x, and u_xx during training in the baseline and PCA methods.
protocol.pca_scope: PCA k=8 is fitted on training-time snapshots only; validation and test times are excluded.
protocol.loss: L = MSE_data + lambda_PDE * MSE_residual + MSE_initial; only lambda_PDE varies for PCA.
protocol.validation_test: Validation metrics are monitored at checkpoints; test metrics are calculated only at the final checkpoint.
protocol.timing: Compilation is excluded from training time and reported separately. PCA pipeline time includes the training-only PCA fit.
protocol.pde_metric: PDE residual validation and test metrics use the same grid finite-difference scoring operator for every method; training uses JAX autodiff for every method.
